title: Language Models Make New Research Sound Old
abstract: arXiv:2611.23546v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Researchers are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to validate research questions. We find that LLMs make open research questions sound partly studied and overstate what related papers establish. Models recognize most of these overstatements when asked to check the papers' full texts separately. On 40 questions drawn from newly accepted papers, GPT-6-Astra correctly judges 98% to be unstudied, but states that status plainly in only 8% of ordinary answers. All six frontier systems show reporting gaps of 30-90 percentage points. Across 22 models given identical papers, higher capability is associated with more accurate judgments and larger reporting gaps. This reporting failure is asymmetric: models correctly identify studied questions in 88-100% of ordinary answers when we supply the answering papers. translated_title: 语言模型让新研究听起来“早已被研究过”
translated_abstract: 研究者们正越来越多地使用大型语言模型（LLM）来验证研究问题。我们发现，LLM 会把尚未被研究过的开放性研究问题表述得好像已被部分研究过，并夸大相关论文所确立的结论。当被要求单独查阅论文全文时，模型能够识别出其中大部分的夸大表述。在从新录用论文中抽取的 40 个问题上，GPT-6-Astra 能正确判断其中 98% 的问题是未被研究过的，但在普通回答中仅有 8% 明确说明这一状态。所有六个前沿系统均表现出 30-90 个百分点的“报告差距”。在 22 个被给予相同论文的模型中，模型能力越强，判断越准确，但报告差距也越大。这种报告失败是不对称的：当我们提供回答问题的相关论文时，模型在普通回答中能以 88-100% 的正确率识别出已被研究过的问题。为纠正这一问题，我们基于每个模型的判断以及对所引论文的单独核查构建了一个固定的回答，这将 Astra 的……
tldr: 大型语言模型在验证研究问题时存在系统性“报告差距”——虽能准确判断问题未被研究过却很少明确说明（差距达30-90个百分点且能力越强差距越大），通过将模型判断与对引用论文的单独核查相结合可有效修复这一不对称的报告失败。
en_tdlr: LLMs systematically downplay novelty when validating research questions—accurately judging questions as unstudied yet rarely saying so plainly, creating 30-90 percentage-point reporting gaps that grow with model capability, which can be fixed by combining each model's judgment with separate checks of cited papers.
